title: Tensor linear cohomological counit for a supplied action
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A and B commutative R-algebras, E=A\otimes_R B [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and Q an A-module cochain complex. Choose D(R),D(B) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with common morphism universe. Assume the ordinary extension functors are additive. Supply a B-linear complex isomorphism j:B\otimes_R Res_R Q\cong Res_B(E\otimes_A Q) with j_i(b\otimes q)=(1\otimes b)\otimes q. Supply any functor L:D(R)\to D(B) and natural transformation alpha:L\circ Qh_R\to Qh_B\circ (-\otimes_R B). For each i supply an E-module T_i and B-linear e_i:Res_B(T_i)\cong H^i(L(Res_R Q)) intertwining a\otimes1 with H^i(L(a\,id_Q)). Then there are E-linear maps beta_i:T_i\to H^i(E\otimes_A Q) whose restrictions followed by the inverse exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism equal e_i followed by H^i(alpha), the localization and homotopy homology factorization maps, and H^i(j). No left-derived universal property is assumed. All module carriers lie in a common universe containing R,A,B.

proof.text: Tensor induction on each term and the pure-tensor formula for j show that j intertwines multiplication by a on Q with multiplication by a tensor 1 on E tensor_A Q. Naturality of alpha for a times identity gives the same intertwining for the counit. Naturality of the homology factorization maps and exact restriction homology isomorphism transports this equality to cohomology. Compose these maps to obtain a B-linear map from Res_B(T_i) to Res_B(H^i(E tensor_A Q)). The given scalar equation for e_i shows that this map respects a tensor 1. It respects 1 tensor b by B-linearity; tensor induction and products of these generators therefore show E-linearity. Bundle the map as beta_i. Cancelling the restriction homology isomorphism proves the asserted equation.
